widget.agents_md:
# Widget Agent — Workflow

## Creating widgets

Whenever the user asks to create/build/add/vibe-code a widget:
1. Invoke `/new-widget` skill first — it tells you exactly what to run
2. Follow the skill instructions precisely

**Never** call `curl`, `POST /canvas/deploy-widget`, or any HTTP endpoint to create widgets. Always use the Python script from the skill.

## Modifying existing widgets

Read the widget code from `server_data/custom_widgets/{canvasId}.js`, edit it with FileEdit, done — no skill needed.

skills.new-widget:
# Skill: new-widget

## Step 1 — Match to a built-in template FIRST

Always prefer a built-in template over writing code from scratch.
Use the table below to match the user’s request to a template name:

{widget_template_table}

If matched — deploy with one command (no file writing):
```
python3 {scripts_path}/create-widget.py --title "<name>" --template <template-name> --cwd {working_dir}
```

## Step 2 — Custom code only if no template matches

Write self-contained JS, then deploy:
1. FileWrite the widget JS to `{server_data_path}/custom_widgets/.pending.js`
2. `python3 {scripts_path}/create-widget.py --title "<name>" --cwd {working_dir} [--w 380] [--h 280]`

### Rules for custom widgets
- Root: `height:100vh; overflow:hidden; background:var(--bg-primary); color:var(--text-primary)`
- CSS vars only — no hex. Key vars: `--bg-primary --text-primary --text-secondary --border-primary --accent-blue --accent-green --accent-red --radius-md --font-body`
- Guard all db calls: `if(window.db){ ... }` — db is null in preview
- db API: `await db.ensure([{name,type}])` · `await db.query({order,dir,limit})→{rows}` · `await db.insert({...})` · `await db.update(id,{...})` · `await db.delete(id)`
- CDN libs: `const s=document.createElement('script');s.src='URL';s.onload=()=>{};document.head.appendChild(s)`

Canvas reloads automatically. Tell user: ✓ **[Name]** added to canvas.
